widgets_values: [keyframe completion] A single continuous cinematic shot follows the supplied pictures in order, from Picture 1 through Picture 8. Keep the same subject, identity, clothing, props and environment throughout. Smooth natural movement connects the successive poses and compositions.

widgets_values:
How the reference pictures align with the target video - Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 2) aligns with the 6.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Stylized 3D CG, dark fantasy, a wide shot begins in the volcanic wasteland and dramatic composition established by Picture 1. The black-armored dark lord Sauron stands on the tall rocky outcrop at screen-right, while the white wizard Saruman stands below at screen-left, preserving their character designs, relative positions, the cracked lava ground, smoke-filled background, fiery glow, and ominous lighting. Sauron turns his focus toward Saruman, raises his hand, and forcefully unleashes a surge of dark magical power toward him. A violent energy blast streaks across the frame and strikes Saruman, creating a burst of sparks, ash, and shockwave-like force. Saruman is thrown out of view by the impact. The camera holds the confrontation for a brief beat as volcanic smoke swirls through the frame, then the image transitions into a quick fade to black. [Shot 2] At 00:03.400, the shot fades in from black to a closer low-angle view of a jagged rocky spur in the same burning wasteland. Saruman is initially not visible. Embers drift through the air and smoke rolls behind the rock face. After a brief moment, his hands suddenly appear gripping the edge of the spur from below. He slowly pulls himself upward, visibly battered, ash-stained, and exhausted. His white robe, hair, and beard are smeared with soot and dirt. His expression is strained and determined as he struggles for breath. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed while he drags his upper body onto the ledge and settles into the exact injured, clinging pose, framing, environment, and lighting established by Picture 2 at the end of the video.

overall_soundscape: A heavy volcanic ambience fills the scene with distant rumbling, crackling lava, drifting ash, and smoky wind. Sauron's attack releases a sharp magical burst followed by a forceful impact and scattering debris. During the fade to black, the sound briefly drops, then the second shot features scraping rock, shifting gravel, fabric movement, small falling stones, and Saruman's strained breathing as he pulls himself upward.

non_diegetic_music: Low orchestral drones at a slow tempo, joined by deep brass pulses and restrained percussion as the magical attack is launched. After the fade to black, sparse low strings return and gradually build tension as Saruman reemerges.

nodes.title: RP Smart Image Size
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Choose the model, resolution tier and aspect-ratio preset. Width and height drive the core Empty Image node; Preview Image displays the resulting canvas. The text previews show the exact ratio and numeric resolution. No model download is needed: this example creates a solid-color image. Use width/height to configure a latent or generator in your own workflow.

ITALIANO

Scegli modello, classe di risoluzione e formato. Larghezza e altezza pilotano Empty Image; Preview Image mostra il risultato. Le anteprime testuali mostrano rapporto esatto e risoluzione numerica. Non occorre caricare un modello: questo esempio crea un’immagine a tinta unita. Nel tuo workflow puoi usare width/height per configurare un latent o un generatore.

nodes.title: RP Smart Image Resize
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Choose an image in Load Image, then run this group. Automatic mode selects a model preset close to the source aspect ratio; manual mode exposes the selected preset and width/height controls. The original mask is connected too, so image and mask stay aligned. Preview Image shows the resized image; Mask to Image displays the resized mask. Interpolation, crop/padding and alignment are configurable.

ITALIANO

Scegli un’immagine in Load Image ed esegui il gruppo. Automatic sceglie un preset del modello vicino al rapporto dell’immagine; manual permette di impostare preset, larghezza e altezza. Anche la maschera originale è collegata, così immagine e maschera restano allineate. Le anteprime mostrano immagine e maschera ridimensionate. Puoi scegliere interpolazione, ritaglio/padding e allineamento.

nodes.title: RP Image Minimum 1K
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Load an image and run. If its longer side is below 1024 pixels, the node enlarges it to 1024 while preserving aspect ratio. Images already at or above 1024 pass through unchanged; it never downscales them. This is ordinary image resizing, not an AI upscaler.

ITALIANO

Carica un’immagine ed esegui. Se il lato lungo è inferiore a 1024 pixel, il nodo lo porta a 1024 mantenendo le proporzioni. Le immagini già almeno 1024 passano inalterate: il nodo non le riduce. È un normale ridimensionamento, non un upscale tramite AI.

nodes.title: RP Load Prompt from File
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Prepare images in input/rp_examples/images and a text file input/rp_examples/prompts.txt. Write one prompt block per image, separated by a line containing *. Connect image_context from the folder loader: its index selects the matching prompt. With require_matching_count enabled, the number of blocks must match the image count. This example displays the first prompt and its number; use the prompt output in a text encoder inside a folder loop for batch processing.

ITALIANO

Prepara immagini in input/rp_examples/images e il file input/rp_examples/prompts.txt. Scrivi un blocco di prompt per immagine, separando i blocchi con una riga contenente *. Collega image_context del loader: il suo indice seleziona il prompt corrispondente. Con require_matching_count attivo, blocchi e immagini devono avere lo stesso numero. Qui vengono mostrati il primo prompt e il suo numero; in un loop collega prompt a un encoder testuale.

nodes.title: RP Save Image to Folder (No Loop)
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

The folder loader supplies one image and its image_context. Upscale Image By demonstrates a processing stage; the RP node saves that result, keeping the source filename, then returns the same image to Preview Image. Output is relative to ComfyUI/output. This node does not start or advance a loop: here only the first image is processed. In a batch workflow, place it before the single RP Save Images to Folder controller to save intermediate stages.

ITALIANO

Il loader fornisce un’immagine e il relativo image_context. Upscale Image By simula un’elaborazione; il nodo RP salva il risultato mantenendo il nome originale, poi restituisce la stessa immagine all’anteprima. L’output è relativo a ComfyUI/output. Questo nodo non avvia né avanza il loop: qui elabora solo la prima immagine. Nei batch mettilo prima dell’unico RP Save Images to Folder per salvare passaggi intermedi.

nodes.title: RP Load Images from Folder & RP Save Images to Folder
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Set images_folder to an absolute folder or a folder relative to ComfyUI/input. Supported images are read in deterministic natural filename order.
Once the images folder is set, start a single run. The RP controller processes every source image through Upscale Image By and saves each result with its original filename. All three connections are required: flow from the loader, processed_image from the last processing node, and image_context from the loader. Use only one loop controller per loader. clear_output_folder and overwrite are disabled. Relative output folders are inside ComfyUI/output.

ITALIANO

Imposta images_folder con una cartella assoluta oppure relativa a ComfyUI/input. Le immagini supportate vengono lette in ordine naturale dei nomi. 
Una volta impostata images_folder, avvia una sola esecuzione. Il controller RP elabora tutte le immagini tramite Upscale Image By e salva ogni risultato con il nome originale. Servono tutti e tre i collegamenti: flow dal loader, processed_image dall’ultimo nodo di elaborazione e image_context dal loader. Usa un solo controller per loader. clear_output_folder e overwrite sono disattivati. L’output relativo si trova in ComfyUI/output.

nodes.title: RP Frames to Video
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Choose/upload a video, then Queue once. RP Video to Frames starts the loop; Upscale Image By resizes each frame to 50%; RP Frames to Video saves each processed frame and assembles the final video. Connect flow and video_context directly from the start node, and processed_image from the processing chain. The original FPS is retained and audio is copied when present. processed_video.mp4 is saved inside the processed-frames folder, under output/rp_examples/video_loop/processed. FFmpeg is required.

ITALIANO

Scegli/carica un video e avvia una sola esecuzione. RP Video to Frames avvia il loop; Upscale Image By riduce ogni frame al 50%; RP Frames to Video salva i frame elaborati e assembla il video. Collega flow e video_context direttamente dal nodo iniziale e processed_image dalla catena di elaborazione. Mantiene gli FPS originali e copia l’audio se presente. processed_video.mp4 viene salvato nella cartella dei frame elaborati, output/rp_examples/video_loop/processed. Serve FFmpeg.

nodes.title: RP Image Comparer
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Load an image and Queue this group. image_a receives the original; image_b receives a 50% resized version. Move the pointer over the comparison to reveal the two images. The comparer_mode property supports Slide, Click and Side-by-side. Set Display name and Save name to control downloaded PNG names. Right-click the desired side and choose Save Image. You can replace the resize branch with any processing or generation chain.

ITALIANO

Carica un’immagine ed esegui il gruppo. image_a riceve l’originale; image_b la versione ridotta al 50%. Muovi il puntatore sul confronto per vedere le due immagini. La proprietà comparer_mode supporta Slide, Click e Side-by-side. Display name e Save name controllano il nome del PNG scaricato. Clic destro sul lato desiderato e Save Image per scaricarlo. Puoi sostituire il resize con qualsiasi elaborazione o generazione.

nodes.title: RP Preview Image
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Choose an image and Queue this group to display it with its exact dimensions and aspect ratio. Display name identifies the preview; Save name is a filename template. The default template includes that display name and a timestamp. Right-click the preview and choose Save Image to download the displayed PNG. With a batch, use the preview arrows to switch images. Replace Load Image with the output of your own image-processing chain.

ITALIANO

Scegli un’immagine ed esegui il gruppo per visualizzarla con dimensioni esatte e rapporto d’aspetto. Display name identifica l’anteprima; Save name è un template per il nome del file. Quello predefinito include nome e data/ora. Clic destro sull’anteprima e Save Image per scaricare il PNG visualizzato. Nei batch usa le frecce per cambiare immagine. Puoi sostituire Load Image con l’output della tua catena.

nodes.title: RP Import Workflow
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

This is an editor utility: use its buttons without running the queue. Refresh saved workflows, select a JSON from the current user’s workflows folder, then Import saved workflow. Choose file to import accepts JSON files from another folder and supports multiple selections. placement/gap control where the imported nodes go; group_import wraps each imported file in a group. Existing nodes and valid links are kept. The source JSON is not overwritten. Save the combined canvas when ready.

ITALIANO

È uno strumento per l’editor: usa i pulsanti senza avviare la coda. Aggiorna l’elenco, scegli un JSON dalla cartella workflows dell’utente e premi Import saved workflow. Choose file to import accetta JSON da altre cartelle, anche multipli. placement/gap decidono la posizione; group_import racchiude ogni file importato in un gruppo. Mantiene nodi esistenti e collegamenti validi. Non sovrascrive il JSON sorgente. Salva il canvas unito quando vuoi conservarlo.

nodes.title: RP Fix Workflow
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

This button acts on the entire current canvas, including subgraphs, without queue execution. Fix workflow removes stale links to absent nodes and invalid link/reroute references, preserving existing nodes, valid connections and settings. The green notification reports repairs or says the workflow is already clean. Fix workflow and save also saves with the current workflow name, overwriting its saved file without asking for another name. It cannot recreate missing nodes or install missing custom nodes.

ITALIANO

Il pulsante agisce su tutto il canvas corrente, inclusi i subgraph, senza eseguire la coda. Fix workflow elimina link verso nodi assenti e riferimenti non validi di link/reroute, mantenendo nodi presenti, collegamenti validi e impostazioni. La notifica verde mostra le correzioni o indica che il workflow è già pulito. Fix workflow and save salva anche con il nome corrente, sovrascrivendo il file senza chiedere un altro nome. Non ricrea nodi mancanti né installa custom node assenti.

nodes.title: RP H3-Keyframes
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

Complete FastH3 example adapted from your saved MiniMax_FastH3 workflow. Choose eight still images in order and verify the H3 model, text encoder and both VAEs. RP H3-Keyframes receives H3 conditioning, the video VAE and the same AV latent used by the sampler. It automatically spaces the connected stills across the exact video length; connecting an input reveals the next, up to 32. Each input needs one image. crop=center fits by centered cropping; disabled stretches. The output conditioning goes to BasicGuider; the sampled AV latent is decoded to video and audio, then saved.

ITALIANO

Esempio FastH3 completo ricavato dal tuo MiniMax_FastH3 salvato. Scegli otto immagini in ordine e verifica modello H3, encoder testuale e i due VAE. RP H3-Keyframes riceve conditioning H3, VAE video e lo stesso latent AV del sampler. Distribuisce automaticamente le immagini sulla durata esatta; collegando un input compare il successivo, fino a 32. Ogni input richiede una singola immagine. crop=center adatta con ritaglio centrale; disabled deforma alle dimensioni richieste. Il conditioning va a BasicGuider; il latent AV campionato viene decodificato in video e audio e salvato.

nodes.title: RP Groups Muter - EN / IT
widgets_values:
ENGLISH

RP Groups Muter lists groups and reads their actual node modes. Click Enable to mute or enable the executable nodes; the arrow navigates to that group. Notes and editor controls do not make a muted group appear active. The node stays synchronized after manual changes and reopening the workflow. In Properties, matchTitle filters names (including regular expressions), matchColors filters colors, sort chooses position/alphanumeric, and showNav controls arrows. This example lists groups 01–12 and excludes its own group. No queue execution is needed.

ITALIANO

RP Groups Muter elenca i gruppi e legge la modalità reale dei nodi. Clicca Enable per disattivare o attivare i nodi eseguibili; la freccia porta al gruppo. Note e controlli dell’editor non fanno apparire attivo un gruppo disattivato. Il nodo resta sincronizzato dopo modifiche manuali e riapertura. Nelle proprietà, matchTitle filtra i nomi (anche con espressioni regolari), matchColors filtra i colori, sort ordina per posizione/nome e showNav controlla le frecce. Questo esempio mostra i gruppi 01–12 ed esclude il proprio gruppo. Non serve eseguire la coda.

Note e controlli dell’editor non fanno apparire attivo un gruppo disattivato. Il nodo resta sincronizzato dopo modifiche manuali e riapertura. Nelle proprietà, matchTitle filtra i nomi (anche con espressioni regolari), matchColors filtra i colori, sort ordina per posizione/nome e showNav controlla le frecce. Questo esempio mostra i gruppi 01–12 ed esclude il proprio gruppo. Non serve eseguire la coda.
